items.prompt: Breakfast in a long dim room of an old house: five students sit at a table, and a very tall thin stranger has just walked in without knocking, standing in the doorway against the light, his face in shadow. Everyone has gone still.

alt.ru: Завтрак в длинной полутёмной комнате: пятеро учеников за столом, в дверях без стука встал очень высокий худой незнакомец, лицо в тени, все замерли.
alt.en: Breakfast in a long dim room: five students at a table, a very tall thin stranger standing unannounced in the doorway against the light, face in shadow, everyone frozen.
alt.pt: Pequeno-almoço numa sala comprida e escura: cinco alunos à mesa, um estranho muito alto e magro à porta contra a luz, rosto na sombra, todos imóveis.
alt.es: Desayuno en una sala larga y oscura: cinco alumnos a la mesa, un desconocido muy alto y delgado en la puerta a contraluz, la cara en sombra, todos inmóviles.
